method: Opened each PNG directly with view_image during the import audit.
scope: Historical captures at 6899f35 / SAVE3 only. No new browser run, hardware test, perceptual study, or contrast measurement.

entries.observation: Native Display dialog shows the Deuteranopia palette, both options checked, and eight labeled marker examples with distinct shapes.
Production gameplay shows visible ownership rings and small player markers around the starting faction; tactical map and idle alert are visible.
Reloaded Display dialog shows Tritanopia with shapes and ownership outlines unchecked; all eight examples use square markers.
Production gameplay shows a selected Scrapper, its selection panel and ring, a visible virtual cursor, and the holding-position message.
Native Saves dialog shows autosaves enabled at 30 seconds and both Autosave and Autosave (previous) rows after the third captured generation.
Native Saves dialog after recovery shows Save downloaded and the current and previous autosave rows. Full-envelope recovery equality is established by JSON comparison, not this screenshot.
Reopened Saves dialog at the menu shows Enable autosaves unchecked and 30 seconds selected; manual save/export are disabled before a match starts.
